svg.title: Known-best packing of 199 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=199 construction, never the source witness: its exact frame with the free grid slack closed and the near-axis squares straightened at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-09 rational corner Witness/v2 at 199: the n = 172 packing of issue 935 (T-282), its exact corners unchanged, plus an L of 27 axis-aligned unit grid squares at side S172 + 1, read exactly from the retained source file. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, same-packing, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=199 regularized: side ~ 14.61468985 (certified upper bound)
